subsystems.name: Vacuum system
subsystems.role: creates the low-pressure environment so vaporized atoms travel to the substrate without colliding with air molecules.

subsystems.name: Precursor and source delivery
subsystems.role: supplies the elements to be deposited as vapor or gas.

subsystems.name: Substrate stage
subsystems.role: holds and positions the wafer or part, often heated to promote surface reactions.

subsystems.name: Activation and patterning
subsystems.role: provides energy to break chemical bonds or direct deposition to precise locations.

subsystems.name: Process control
subsystems.role: monitors thickness and composition in real time to stop at the atomic layer.

subsystems.name: Cleanroom and handling
subsystems.role: keeps contamination away from the atomic-scale process.

buildSteps.title: Design the layer stack
buildSteps.detail: Decide which materials and thicknesses are needed, sometimes down to single atomic layers, for the device.

buildSteps.title: Clean and load the substrate
buildSteps.detail: Remove organic and particle contamination, then transfer the substrate into the vacuum chamber through a load-lock.

buildSteps.title: Pump to high vacuum
buildSteps.detail: Evacuate the chamber to below 10^-6 pascal (ultra-high vacuum) so residual gas does not disrupt the beam or film.

buildSteps.title: Generate vapor
buildSteps.detail: Heat a solid source until it evaporates, sputter atoms off a target with ions, or introduce a chemical precursor gas.

buildSteps.title: Direct the vapor
buildSteps.detail: Guide the atoms to the substrate, either broadly or through a focused ion beam or mask for patterned deposition.

buildSteps.title: Deposit the film
buildSteps.detail: Atoms land on the surface and bond, forming a thin layer; in ALD, the surface reaction self-limits to one atomic layer per cycle.

buildSteps.title: Repeat cycles
buildSteps.detail: Purge excess precursor and repeat the cycle to build up the desired thickness layer by layer.

buildSteps.title: Anneal or activate
buildSteps.detail: Heat or plasma-treat the film to improve crystal quality or activate dopants.

buildSteps.title: Measure and finish
buildSteps.detail: Use in-situ or ex-situ metrology to confirm thickness and composition, then package the device.

prerequisites.why: needed to keep the deposition environment free of contaminants that would disrupt atomic layers.
self-limiting surface reactions that enable true one-atom-layer control.
available for nanoscale deposition and etching, but sub-nanometer precision and high throughput are not yet routine.
many metals and oxides have volatile precursors, but others lack suitable chemistry for ALD or CVD.
tools like STM and TEM can image atoms, but integrating them into production deposition is challenging.

pathway.milestone: ALD is used in high-volume semiconductor manufacturing for gate dielectrics and barriers
pathway.unlocks: reliable, uniform films only a few atoms thick in mass-produced chips.

pathway.milestone: area-selective deposition to place material only where needed
pathway.unlocks: fewer lithography steps and lower-cost nanoscale patterning.

pathway.milestone: direct-write focused ion beam deposition for prototyping quantum and nanoscale devices
pathway.unlocks: rapid iteration on exotic material combinations without masks.

pathway.milestone: atomic-precision manufacturing of 3D structures with multiple materials
pathway.unlocks: new classes of electronics, sensors and quantum devices built atom by atom.
